mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 71 degrees and partly cloudy at Badger Prairie County Park, and we have a Full Moon tonight. You can also catch the International Space Station passing high in the sky tonight starting at 7:47 PM, rising near Cross Plains and heading toward Oregon.

In city news, Hwy M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 5 to October 7 for final paving and shoulder work, so please use the detours on Old PB and Verona Avenue. Additionally, ongoing utility work continues to impact traffic patterns in that area.

There is plenty to do, with Live Music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee both happening today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by a busy Tuesday featuring trivia at Hop Haus and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park.

In a noteworthy call from the police department, a driver was arrested for operating with a prohibited alcohol concentration, which is an O W I offence, after being stopped for speeding on September 5.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, Turtle, at our local Culver's. We are currently open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by soon to grab a scoop.
